Prevention: Maintain or plant flower strips to attract natural enemies of psyllids such as ladybird beetles and lacewings larvae.
Citrus greening disease is transmitted by the psyllids.
Disease symptoms can be confused with zinc deficiency.
Using appropriate fertilizers containing zinc micronutrient to avoid confusion.
